title: Europe’s preparedness push
summary: Following the household advice and resilience policies taking shape across Europe.
focus: Compare the EU strategy with national campaigns, then examine changes in implementation and public resources.
questions: Which measures are policy announcements, and which have been implemented?
What changed between the 2023–2025 period and the latest campaigns?

title: The machinery of military readiness
summary: Examining the exercises and logistics used to prepare for large-scale operations.
focus: Build comparable records of exercise size, transport use and actual activation before assessing new military activity.
questions: How does announced participation compare with actual activity?
Are later exercises different in scale, duration or transport demand?

title: Military medicine: from authority to delivery
summary: Tracing the decisions between an emergency-use declaration and treatment reaching military units.
focus: Track product-specific decisions, obligations and delivery records connected to military medical preparedness.
questions: Which product-specific decisions followed the declaration?
What do procurement and delivery records establish?
